product_overview: Aprenda+ is a gamified web platform for learning Mathematics and Portuguese that engages students with progression mechanics (XP, coins, lives), lessons, a virtual store and leaderboards. The system uses Supabase for auth and data storage and provides REST endpoints for lessons, economy and user management (see PRD pages 1-4).
core_goals: Increase engagement through gamified progression (XP, coins, levels, streaks)
Improve retention using leaderboards, customizable avatars and a store
Provide an accessible, responsive mobile-first UI with performant route loading
Ensure secure authentication and account recovery via Supabase
Support scalable lesson and content additions and future admin tooling

features.name: Authentication & Account Management
features.description: Email/password sign-up, login, session protection for private routes, and password recovery (/update-password). (See PRD section 4.1, pages 1-2.)
user_flows: POST /api/auth/signup with {email, password} -> Receive 201 Created with user id and email verification hint -> POST /api/auth/login with {email, password} -> Receive 200 with JWT access token -> GET /api/profile with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with user profile
POST /api/auth/signup with existing email -> Receive 409 Conflict with error 'email already exists'
POST /api/auth/login with incorrect password -> Receive 401 Unauthorized with error 'invalid credentials'
POST /api/auth/request-password-reset with {email} -> Receive 200 with 'reset email sent' -> POST /update-password with {token, new_password} -> Receive 200 password updated
POST /update-password with invalid or expired token -> Receive 400 Bad Request with error 'invalid or expired token'

features.name: Journey & Exercise Selection
features.description: Browse learning tracks and choose exercises by discipline (Matemática, Português). Frontend routes include /exercises and a journey map. (See PRD section 4.2, page 2 and routing in section 5.2, page 3.)
user_flows: GET /api/exercises?subject=matematica with valid token -> Receive 200 with list of available exercise sets and meta (difficulty, xp_reward)
GET /api/exercises without token -> Receive 401 Unauthorized
GET /api/journey with valid token -> Receive 200 with user's progression map and unlocked nodes
GET /api/journey with malformed token -> Receive 401 Unauthorized

features.name: Lesson System (Quizzes, Lives, Timer)
features.description: Dynamic multiple-choice lessons per subject with lives, optional timed questions, and rewards (XP, coins). Routes include /lesson/:subject for fetching questions and submit endpoints for answers. (See PRD section 4.3, page 2.)
user_flows: GET /api/lesson/matematica with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with question set (id, choices, time_limit)
GET /api/lesson/matematica without token -> Receive 401 Unauthorized
POST /api/lesson/answer with {lesson_id, question_id, choice_id} and token -> Receive 200 with {correct: true, xp_awarded, coins_awarded, remaining_lives}
POST /api/lesson/answer with incorrect payload (missing question_id) -> Receive 400 Bad Request with validation errors
POST /api/lesson/complete with {lesson_id} and token -> Receive 200 with summary {xp_total, coins_total, streak_updated}
POST /api/lesson/complete with lesson_id not found -> Receive 404 Not Found

features.name: Economy & Store
features.description: Virtual store to spend coins on items and power-ups (e.g., 'pause time'). Purchases debit coins and update inventory. (See PRD section 4.4, page 2.)
user_flows: GET /api/store/items with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with list of items (id, price, stock, effects)
POST /api/store/purchase with {item_id} and token -> Receive 200 with {purchase_id, new_balance, item_granted}
POST /api/store/purchase with {item_id} and token when user has insufficient coins -> Receive 402 Payment Required with error 'insufficient coins'
POST /api/store/purchase with invalid item_id -> Receive 404 Not Found

features.name: Leaderboard (Ranking)
features.description: Global and filtered leaderboards showing top users by XP or level, supporting pagination and filters. (See PRD section 4.4, page 2.)
user_flows: GET /api/leaderboard?metric=xp&page=1&limit=20 -> Receive 200 with list of users sorted by xp and pagination meta
GET /api/leaderboard?metric=unknown -> Receive 400 Bad Request with error 'invalid metric parameter'

features.name: Profile & Customization
features.description: View and edit profile (name, avatar), view stats (accuracy, streak), and history. (See PRD section 4.4 and 4.5, pages 2-3.)
user_flows: GET /api/profile with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with profile {name, avatar_url, xp, coins, stats}
PATCH /api/profile with Authorization: Bearer <token> and {name, avatar_id} -> Receive 200 with updated profile
PATCH /api/profile with invalid avatar_id -> Receive 400 Bad Request with error 'invalid avatar'
GET /api/profile without token -> Receive 401 Unauthorized

features.name: Healthcheck API
features.description: Lightweight endpoint to verify backend status and uptime. (Defined in the codebase; see code summary feature 'Healthcheck API' and server.js.)
user_flows: GET /api/healthcheck -> Receive 200 with {status: 'ok', message: 'service healthy', timestamp}
GET /api/healthcheck when server has internal error -> Receive 500 Internal Server Error with {status: 'error', message: 'service unavailable'}
